decidedBy: the lead, 2026-10-08, deciding option (a) of PRB-0476 for the three peoples no text writes in a language we carry: the Calebites and the Gederathites are given the word that names them, an agent having read 1 Samuel 25:3 and 1 Chronicles 12:5 against the Hebrew; no person has reviewed this ruling
policy: A people the dictionary derives, whose name a word of the Hebrew text writes, is that word's answer. The Calebites are the house of Caleb, Nabal's; the Gederathite of 1 Chronicles 12 is a man of Gederah.
source: Essenthos, the Calebite of 1 Samuel 25:3 and the Gederathite of 1 Chronicles 12:5 (English 12:4) in BHSA, read on 2026-10-08

rulings.why: 'and he was of the house of Caleb': the written text has כלבו and the reading tradition (qere) כָּלִבִּי, a Calebite, which the King James follows; the Septuagint takes the word as 'dog-like' (κυνικός), a reading this ruling does not follow. The word names the people descended from Caleb.

'and Jozabad the Gederathite': הַגְּדֵרָתִי is the gentilic of Gederah (Strong's H1452, a patrial from H1449), one of the Benjamites who came to David at Ziklag. The word names the people of Gederah, of which Jozabad is one.
